title: Authority metadata and evidence are fail-closed, non-capabilities, and readiness-honest
statement: Every live action MUST declare an explicit effect, constitutional authority subject, consent, planner, and final boundary with no default-to-read fallback; every governed mutation MUST emit secret-safe audit-only authority provenance, and shadow, dry-run, read, denial, ambiguity, unclassified targets, or unverified host posture MUST remain ineligible to promote supported readiness.
rationale: A correct decision cannot compensate for an action omitted from the registry, and durable evidence must never become a replayable capability or an inflated production-readiness claim.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
